AlarmState.title: Alarm State
AlarmState.description: Represents the state and configuration of the PIR alarm system.

isArmed.description: Indicates if the alarm system is currently armed.

presenceDetected.description: True if the PIR sensor has detected presence.

alarmDuration.description: Duration in seconds for the buzzer to sound when triggered.

/alarm/state.description: Singleton location to hold the current state and configuration of the alarm.
